footer.tagline: Contract-first payment infrastructure for Brazilian merchants.
footer.built_for: Built for the Phase 5 milestone of the iris-gate roadmap.

hero.body: IrisGate ships idempotent payment intents, real-time anti-fraud, and a contract-first SDK so the gateway never drifts from your backend.

trust.contracts: OpenAPI + AsyncAPI as source of truth

integration.title: Contract-first SDK that breaks builds, not production.
integration.body: Every endpoint and event is defined in OpenAPI / AsyncAPI. The TypeScript SDK is generated from the same source — rename a field on the backend and your frontend type-check fails before merge.

bullets.openapi: OpenAPI 3.1 + AsyncAPI 2.6 published with the gateway
bullets.idempotency: Idempotency-Key on every mutation by default
bullets.clients: Typed clients for Web, Node and Go consumers

integration.image_alt: Code editor showing the IrisGate TypeScript SDK

monitoring.title: Real-time risk scoring with rules you can read and tune.
monitoring.body: Suspicious accounts, unusual amounts and frequent high-value bursts are scored asynchronously through Kafka with at-least-once Inbox semantics. Decisions stream back as fraud.assessment.completed.v1 events you can route anywhere.

bullets.rules: Score-and-weight rules registered in Postgres (no code redeploy)
bullets.exactly_once: Inbox dedupe + Outbox publishing for end-to-end exactly-once
bullets.dlq: DLQ topic isolates terminal failures without blocking the stream

reporting.title: Audit trails and reconciliation that your finance team trusts.
reporting.body: Every payment intent, authorization, capture and refund is persisted with a full event history. Export reconciled balances or stream them to your ledger.

bullets.event_store: Append-only event store with reproducible state
bullets.exports: CSV / JSON exports with idempotent re-runs
bullets.webhooks: Webhook delivery with HMAC and exponential retry

support.title: Engineers on call, not a contact form.
support.body: Founder-led support during onboarding. Production incidents get a Slack channel with the engineers who wrote the code, not a tier-1 queue.

testimonial.quote: We replaced three legacy services with IrisGate in six weeks. Idempotent authorization and the contract-first SDK alone paid for the migration.

cta.title: Ship a payment integration this sprint, not next quarter.
cta.body: IrisGate ships with first-party SDKs, sandbox acquirers, and a fraud detection pipeline you can audit end-to-end. Get a key in minutes.

brand_panel.body: Authorize, capture and reconcile idempotent payment intents with a contract-first SDK and real-time anti-fraud.
brand_panel.copyright: © {year} IrisGate · Built for the Phase 5 milestone.

form.title: Sign in to the console
form.description: Use the API key issued by your operator with irisctl issue-api-key. Your key stays in an encrypted cookie — it never goes back to the browser.
form.hint: The irk_ prefix identifies sandbox keys; irl_ are live.
form.footer_no_key: Don't have an API key yet?
form.footer_back_suffix: to request access to the private beta.
